entries.title: Selective Regenerative Decoding: Trajectory-Level Intervention for Inference-Time Reasoning
entries.description: A decoding approach that keeps promising reasoning prefixes and regenerates degraded suffixes, rather than discarding whole candidate answers. The paper studies how this finer-grained intervention improves the tradeoff between reasoning quality and inference cost.

entries.title: CHOIR: Harmonizing Structured Persona Diversity for Robust Collaborative LLM Reasoning
entries.description: CHOIR combines reasoning signals from multiple persona-conditioned paths during decoding. It treats differences between counterfactual personas as a resource for more robust reasoning, balancing agreement and divergence without retraining the underlying model.

entries.title: ReasoningRec: Bridging Personalized Recommendations and Human-Interpretable Explanations through LLM Reasoning
entries.description: A recommendation framework that models preferences and explanatory reasoning with language models. A larger model generates synthetic explanations used to fine-tune a smaller model, connecting recommendation accuracy with explanations people can understand.
